Finding-to-fix map:
1. Bounded freshness subprocess transport: child output capture is capped, one deadline covers process exit and pipe drainage, descendants are terminated as a process group, and kill/wait/cleanup results are checked. Files: crates/velnor-actions-freshness/src/process.rs, process/capture.rs, process/tests.rs, tests.rs. Main fixes: 5f719d29a4f985853016a3fdb030a77e82c4c30d, 8d883a843036d03e32f62c258440c20e794242bb, 9cfcc0ef39b8a5f3de89b260b0072066738f85ef, 3359237590520fb4f4e083435af0fa6e89746534.
2. Strict timestamp grammar and checked date/time arithmetic (reject negative clock fields, malformed fractions, overflow). Files: time.rs and freshness tests. Main fix: 5f719d29a4f985853016a3fdb030a77e82c4c30d.
3. Relative `check-freshness.sh --root` preserves the caller’s directory identity across `cd`. File: scripts/check-freshness.sh with a fixture regression. Fix: 9cfcc0ef39b8a5f3de89b260b0072066738f85ef.
4. Canonical trailer migration removes old Python validator and tests, routes local/API validation through the typed Rust private operation, and validates physical Git trailer records. Files: trailer_policy.rs/tests, scripts/validate-commit-trailers.py deletion, scripts/tests/test_validate_commit_trailers.py deletion, docs/implemented/codex-agent-configuration.md and update-procedure.md. Fix: 85bacbc823fe056b4100640f6778d72e98afe87c; mandatory local full-identity wording restored in 9583d3b687586e7ec527f5d22517e068cdb32a6a.
5. HTTP redirects are bounded across hops and intermediate response bodies, including compressed transfer handling; redirect resolution preserves RFC dot/trailing-segment and repeated-slash semantics. Files: probe.rs, probe/transport.rs, probe tests/http.rs. Fixes: 38f8b988a6a122fe25338bf9ff1bb540abe0ccde and 9583d3b687586e7ec527f5d22517e068cdb32a6a.
6. Local URI fixture reads admit bounded regular files and reject FIFOs/devices/unsupported path forms without blocking. Files: probe.rs and probe tests. Fix: 38f8b988a6a122fe25338bf9ff1bb540abe0ccde.
7. Upstream `pkg.rust.version` parsing is structural TOML with required table/key/type, no following-section decoys or malformed quoted values. Files: probe.rs and probe tests. Fix: 38f8b988a6a122fe25338bf9ff1bb540abe0ccde.
8. Holds count only when exact held version matches current pin; duplicate tool/action inventory rows are rejected; unknown unique rows are not admitted to probe state, preventing per-row network fanout. Files: evidence/freshness.rs, evidence/exceptions.rs, inventory/pins.rs, probe tests. Fixes: 5add4ffb0058b7cb165b8497b9a4cc2f130c9810 and 9583d3b687586e7ec527f5d22517e068cdb32a6a.
9. Repository-only support crate ownership is explicit and typed; canonical-repository task derivation excludes only root packages carrying the typed owner after origin verification, while external consumer repositories retain same-named packages. Files: metadata.rs, derive_groups.rs, derive_groups_task_owner_tests.rs, architecture/CLI/rust-quality contracts. Fix: 9583d3b687586e7ec527f5d22517e068cdb32a6a.
10. Earlier quoted Nextest TOML bootstrap parsing is fixed in the bounded AWK helper and regression-covered. File: scripts/toml-tool-pin.awk plus private CLI tests; initial foundation commit ef008ef0d96955d411c49cfefbe449b523f6b9a4.
11. PR #80/PR #76/PR #79 historical reversed trailers and PR #81 missing co-author trailer are recorded from actual commit objects; PR29/30 snapshot is amended with actual reply/closure URLs and timestamps. Files: docs/implemented/commit-trailer-evidence.md and pr29-pr30-disposition-2026-10-05.md. Commit: 9e420020f0373483fecacc757d447eebd5761f47. Published history remains unchanged.
